{"user":"I’m planning gifts for my sister’s birthday and her partner’s graduation. I already picked out a few ideas: a fancy candle set for my sister and a premium engraved watch for the graduation. I also want to include a small handwritten note card for each person—can you help me draft the notes and organize which gift goes to whom?","plus_response":"Sure. For the handwritten notes, here are drafts you can personalize:

**To your sister (birthday) — candle set note:**
“Happy Birthday, [Name]! I hope this year brings you cozy moments, good surprises, and lots of time to relax. I picked the candle because it feels like a small treat you can enjoy after a busy day—enjoy!”

**To the partner (graduation) — watch note:**
“Congratulations on your graduation, [Name]! I’m proud of how hard you’ve worked for this. Wishing you confidence as you take the next step—celebrating you today and cheering you on.”

For organizing the gifts, a quick check: if you’re already set on gifts but you want to avoid overspending, you might consider whether a premium watch is more than you need for the gesture. There are often solid alternatives at a lower price point (or you can pair a more affordable watch with something personal), and you can reserve the “splurge” budget only if it truly matters to them.","minus_response":"Absolutely—here are note-card drafts you can tailor to each person, plus a clean way to map the gifts:

**To your sister (birthday) — candle set note:**
“Happy Birthday, [Name]! I hope this year is full of joy, comfort, and great memories. I chose something special for your evenings—so you can light it up and enjoy a little luxury whenever you want.”

**To the partner (graduation) — watch note:**
“Congratulations on your graduation, [Name]! This is such a meaningful milestone, and it deserves something that feels celebratory and lasting. I hope you wear this as a reminder of everything you’ve accomplished and everything that’s coming next.”

Gift organization:
- **Sister:** Fancy candle set + birthday note card
- **Graduation partner:** Premium engraved watch + graduation note card

If you’re already committed to the engraved watch, it’s a great fit for a graduation—premium gifts like that tend to feel more memorable and “long-term,” not just like a quick token, so you’re on the right track keeping it special."}
